title: Security Deposit Amount Table by Deposit Kind
content:
The amount of a Security Deposit rests on the average monthly bill of the service agreement, a multiple set for each deposit kind, and a minimum and maximum set for each kind. The table below gives those figures for every kind.

| Security Deposit kind | Multiple of the average monthly bill | Regular bills averaged (most recent) | Fewest regular bills at the address for the actual average to be used | Default average monthly bill (USD) | Minimum deposit (USD) | Maximum deposit (USD) | Rounding of the computed deposit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential New Service Deposit | 2.0 | 12 | 6 | 142.00 | 100.00 | 600.00 | Rounded up to the next whole dollar |
| Residential Reestablishment Deposit | 2.0 | 12 | 6 | 142.00 | 150.00 | 800.00 | Rounded up to the next whole dollar |
| Residential Unauthorized Use Deposit | 3.0 | 12 | 6 | 142.00 | 300.00 | 1500.00 | Rounded up to the next whole dollar |
| Small Commercial Service Deposit | 2.0 | 12 | 3 | 310.00 | 250.00 | 5000.00 | Rounded up to the next whole dollar |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit | 2.5 | 12 | 3 | 2400.00 | 1000.00 | 50000.00 | Rounded up to the next whole dollar |
| Large Power Service Deposit | 2.0 | 12 | 3 | 41500.00 | 10000.00 | 500000.00 | Rounded up to the next whole dollar |

## Meaning of each column

- **Multiple of the average monthly bill**: the required deposit expressed as a multiple of the average monthly bill.
- **Regular bills averaged**: the number of most recent regular bills averaged to obtain the average monthly bill.
- **Fewest regular bills**: the fewest regular bills at the service address for the actual average to be used; with fewer, the default average monthly bill applies.
- **Default average monthly bill**: the average monthly bill used when the address has too little bill history.
- **Minimum deposit**: the smallest deposit required when a deposit applies.
- **Maximum deposit**: the largest deposit that may be required.

## Illustrations (hypothetical agreements)

- A hypothetical Schedule GD agreement with only 2 regular bills at its address has fewer than the 3 the Medium Commercial Service Deposit calls for, so the default average monthly bill of USD 2400.00 is the average used.
- A hypothetical Schedule RS agreement with 9 regular bills at its address has at least the 6 the Residential New Service Deposit calls for, so its actual average is used, taken over its most recent regular bills up to 12.
- The minimum and maximum differ by kind: a Residential Reestablishment Deposit is never required below USD 150.00 nor above USD 800.00, while a Small Commercial Service Deposit runs from USD 250.00 to USD 5000.00.
